opening.argument: The speaker presents OneCoin as a company-backed cryptocurrency headed toward public launch, stating that the company is planning this for the third or fourth quarter of 2018 and that the coin could become an even bigger success afterward. The title frames the subject as OneCoin becoming a public cryptocurrency, while the description directs viewers to sign up for an associated webinar. Together, these statements promote anticipated participation in a named token project and its future appreciation, rather than providing independent criticism. Although the speaker concedes that there is no certainty and cannot give an exact date, that qualification does not change the promotional framing of the planned launch and expected success.
